purpose: Frozen real-data RoundValue experiment: MATH development tasks fit/select the cross-domain policy; MATH-100, HumanEval+, and MBPP+ are held-out test tasks.

split_protocol.note: Code results are held-out cross-domain policy evaluations. Do not describe this manifest's train/validation partition as an EvalPlus training split.
split_protocol.test: 100 fixed MATH-500 tasks plus all HumanEval+ and MBPP+ tasks
split_protocol.train: 140 MATH tasks excluding every MATH-500 problem
split_protocol.validation: 60 disjoint MATH tasks excluding every MATH-500 problem
